integrity: Exact analytic theorem with independent rational stationary-chain and matrix-minor checks; finite checks corroborate but do not replace proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Stationary Poisson common resets and independent memoryless species colonization/local-extinction only; identical habitat parameters within the modeled patch population. The one-half bound is not universal under nonexponential recolonization, spatial heterogeneity, or biological interaction. L is latent age-induced covariance, not the raw indicator covariance on the diagonal. Independent bibliographic validation not performed; the Calcagno et al. supplementary appendix was inaccessible.
title: A Cauchy dependence kernel for species under shared habitat catastrophes
